Maya Chen: @here Quick heads-up — we're rolling out a new internal docs + SDK policy for structured response contracts (v2). This tightens the shape we expect from model responses and standardizes an HTTP header `X-Redwood-Response-Contract: 2`. Please read the note below and flag any blockers. :wave:

Devin Patel: TL;DR: this is a compatibility-hardening change. It enforces stronger typing for `choices[].content` and introduces a minimal validation pass in the SDK client. Default behavior: SDK v4.2 will warn on mismatches; v5 will enforce.

Sudhir Rao: A couple of operational notes: 1) runtime will accept both 1.x and 2.0 responses and will add a server-side shim when possible. 2) we'll route unknown-contract responses to a degraded-parsing path (logs + metric: `resp_contract_mismatch`).

Lina Gomez: Where's the migration guide? I need to update the docs site and the quickstart.

DocBot: Migration guide and changelog: https://intranet.redwood/docs/response-contract-v2-migration (internal). Short diff below:

```
- choices[].content: string | null
+ choices[].content: {
+   type: "text" | "structured",
+   value: string | object
+ }
```

Maya Chen: Exact timeline: announcement today. Docs + migration guide published now. SDK warning release (v4.2.0-rc1) will go out next Tue (1739992400). Enforcement release (v5.0) targeted in ~8 weeks. If you rely on free-form `content` strings, add the compatibility shim or update your evals.

Jordan (QA): Will the new validation break existing integration tests? We have ~20 internal tests that parse `choices[].content` as a string.

Devin Patel: Good catch — please run the compatibility checker in the migration repo against your test set. Quick local check: add header to request to opt into legacy mode: `X-Redwood-Response-Contract: 1` or set SDK option: `responseContract.compat_mode = true`. We'll keep legacy mode for two release cycles.

Maya Chen: Action items:
- Maya: publish a small sample migration PR to the examples repo today.
- Devin: ship the SDK warning RC and the SDK docs snippets (owner).
- Jordan/QA: run test sweep and report failures by EOD Friday (1739992000).
- Sudhir: add metrics and logs for mismatch and a short runbook for oncall.

Jordan (QA): Acked. I'll start the sweep and file issues where parsing fails.

Devin Patel: Sample SDK snippet for migration (JS):

```js
// opt in compat mode to suppress warnings for now
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, responseContract: { compat_mode: true } });
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' });
console.log(res.choices[0].content);
```

Maya Chen: Docs note format: short banner at top of relevant pages + migration checklist. We'll add a `breaking-changes` section that captures the exact field changes.

Lina Gomez: I'll coordinate the docs banner content. Can someone drop final approved copy here by EOD?

Devin Patel: Dropping draft copy: "Heads up: schema for model responses is evolving to v2. Update SDKs or enable compat mode. See migration guide (link). Enforcement planned in v5 in ~8 weeks."

Sudhir Rao: Deploy/infra heads up: the runtime shim will add ~2-4ms p95 for shimed requests. We'll only enable shim in the canary region first.

deploy-bot: deploy starting - sdk/v4.2.0-rc1 to canary (region-us-west-2) — build 420-rc. :rocket:

Maya Chen: If you have customers using raw responses (directly hitting hosted API) we need to notify them. CS: please prepare a short customer-facing note and flag any enterprise accounts that need dedicated migration support.

Jordan (QA): Filing checklist items now. Will include sample failing payloads and a suggested test harness snippet.

Devin Patel: One more config snippet for server teams to force response contract header generation (if you manage a private deployment):

```
response_contract:
  enforce_header: true
  default_version: 2
```

Maya Chen: Thanks all. We'll post follow-ups here with RC notes, the PR links, and a timeline tracker. Please react with :eyes: once you've scanned the migration guide.

Lina Gomez: :eyes:

Jordan (QA): :thumbsup:

Devin Patel: :shipit:
